name: Kenny Gilfilen
summary:
AI-Assisted Software Development • Python • Automation • Distributed Systems • System Integration

Software engineer with more than 30 years of experience designing, building, testing, and integrating complex software systems across telecommunications, aviation, medical devices, network infrastructure, and enterprise software.

Experienced in Python development, automation architecture, distributed systems, REST APIs, Linux, cloud technologies, CI/CD, full-stack engineering, and developer productivity. Throughout my career I have focused on solving difficult engineering problems by building reliable automation frameworks, operational tooling, integration platforms, and software that improves quality and accelerates delivery.

Currently expanding into AI-assisted software engineering through hands-on development of LLM-powered applications.

Interested in Software Engineering, AI Engineering, Automation, Platform Engineering, Developer Productivity, and Machine Learning Engineering roles.
